notes: Primary pain: agents waste 20-30s per ticket looking up orders and issuing refunds manually; chargebacks rising during promotions
POC focus: tool-calling to Zendesk (create/update tickets), Ordo OMS (refunds, fulfillment hold), payment gateway (void/refund) — must be transactional or compensating
Throughput target: handle 500-700 tool-calls/sec during peak promo windows; target 99th pct < 400ms for tool-call latency (end-to-end), p50 ~ 70ms
Reliability reqs: idempotency keys for every refund operation, at-least-once delivery with dedupe, exponential backoff + circuit breaker, retry logs in audit trail
Security: SSO/SAML for console, per-call audit logs, KMS for keys, EU data residency for EU customers, retention controls (3 years)
Model routing: want automatic fallback to smaller quantized model on saturation; prefer hosted for rapid iterate but Dedicated for predictable peaks
Agent experience: streaming partial results to agent UI, tool-call confirmations shown inline, undo/confirm workflow for refunds
Quote from CTO (paraphrase): 'Zero tolerance for double refunds. If the model triggers a refund call, we need transactional guarantees or built-in compensations.'
POC success criteria: 1) no double refunds in 1000 simulated refund flows, 2) tool-calls complete < 400ms 95% of time under 1x load, 3) end-to-end audit log for each action
Integration notes: Zendesk via API v2; Ordo OMS has batch endpoints and webhook callbacks; payment gateway requires 3-step handshake for partial refunds
Language support: en + es for agent prompts and summaries; prefer deterministic summarization templates for compliance
Cost sensitivity: moderate — will optimize batching/caching to reduce per-token cost; open to Optimize recommendations on quantization and batching profiles
Legal: sandbox data must be anonymized; legal wants signed DPA and SOC2 attestation before Prod rollout
